import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 600;
    static long mod;
    static class NumberType {
        long val;
        NumberType() { this.val = 0; }
        NumberType(long v) {
            this.val = v % mod;
            if (this.val < 0) this.val += mod;
        }
        NumberType add(NumberType b) {
            return new NumberType((this.val + b.val) % mod);
        }
        NumberType subtract(NumberType b) {
            return new NumberType((this.val - b.val + mod) % mod);
        }
        NumberType multiply(NumberType b) {
            return new NumberType((this.val * b.val) % mod);
        }
        NumberType pow(long e) {
            NumberType res = new NumberType(1);
            NumberType base = new NumberType(this.val);
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) res = res.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
        NumberType inv() {
            return this.pow(mod - 2);
        }
    }

    static NumberType[][] comb = new NumberType[MAXN + 1][MAXN + 1];
    static NumberType[] a = new NumberType[MAXN + 1], c = new NumberType[MAXN + 1];
    static NumberType[][][] dp = new NumberType[MAXN + 1][MAXN + 1][2], dpc = new NumberType[MAXN + 1][MAXN + 1][2];

    static long sumRange(long l, long r) {
        if (l > r) return 0;
        return (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
                if (j == 0 || j == i) {
                    comb[i][j] = new NumberType(1);
                } else {
                    comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1].add(comb[i - 1][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        a[0] = new NumberType(0);
        c[0] = new NumberType(1);
        a[1] = new NumberType(0);
        c[1] = new NumberType(2);

        for (int i = 2; i <= m; ++i) {
            NumberType tmp = new NumberType(0);
            NumberType tmpc = new NumberType(0);
            for (int l = 0; l <= i; ++l) {
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                NumberType sumRangeVal = new NumberType(sumRange(1, l)).add(new NumberType(sumRange(1, r)));
                tmp = tmp.add(
                        c[l].multiply(c[r])
                                .multiply(sumRangeVal)
                                .multiply(comb[i - 1][l])
                );
                NumberType term1 = a[l].multiply(c[r]);
                NumberType term2 = a[r].multiply(c[l]);
                tmp = tmp.add(
                        term1.add(term2).multiply(comb[i - 1][l])
                                .multiply(new NumberType(i + 1))
                );
                tmpc = tmpc.add(
                        c[l].multiply(c[r])
                                .multiply(new NumberType(i + 1))
                                .multiply(comb[i - 1][l])
                );
            }
            a[i] = tmp;
            c[i] = tmpc;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
                    dpc[i][j][k] = new NumberType(0);
                }
            }
        }
        dpc[0][0][0] = new NumberType(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (j > i) continue;
                dpc[i][j][0] = dpc[i - 1][j][0].add(dpc[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; ++k) {
                    dpc[i][j][1] = dpc[i][j][1].add(c[k].multiply(comb[j][k]).multiply(dpc[i - k][j - k][0]));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (j > i) continue;
                dp[i][j][0] = dp[i - 1][j][0].add(dp[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; ++k) {
                    NumberType term1 = a[k].multiply(comb[j][k]).multiply(dpc[i - k][j - k][0]);
                    NumberType term2 = dp[i - k][j - k][0].multiply(c[k]).multiply(comb[j][k]);
                    dp[i][j][1] = dp[i][j][1].add(term1).add(term2);
                }
            }
        }

        long result = (dp[n][m][0].add(dp[n][m][1])).val;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
